name: Doctor Octopus

abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.

howToPlay: Doctor Octopus için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Academic Background
Doctor Octopus's extensive academic background let him start the fight with each of his Research Categories at 60 and each Breakthroughs is replaced by a new effect.
Physics: Power Drain 100% of any power gained and steal [5 - 15]% of the Power Drained.
Biology: Gain the standard Biology Breakthrough Armor Up and [428.57 - 925.37] Armor Penetration while it's active.
Chemistry: Deal Direct Damage equal to 100% of Health Gained and Lifesteal [15 - 25]% of the Damage done.

abilitySections.title: Scientific Method - Passive
content: Research is built in each Category until it hits 100. If you haven't gained research in a category for 10 seconds it begins to fall off.
Each Category grants a Passive effect which scales as its category builds.
When a Category reaches 100 it triggers a Breakthrough, as long as there isn't one already active.
When a Breakthrough effect expires all Research Categories are reset to 0.

abilitySections.title: Physics - Research Category
content: Builds on Opponent Gaining Power.
Scaling Effect: Opponent's Special Attack Damage reduced by up to 50%
Breakthrough: Applies a Power Lock Debuff on the Opponent which lasts 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Chemistry - Research Category
content: Builds on Block or Parry.
Scaling Effect: Increase of up to [2,250] Block Proficiency.
Breakthrough: Applies a Heal Block Debuff to the Opponent which lasts 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Biology - Research Category
content: Builds when landing Hits and when being Struck
Scaling Effect: Passive Fury, granting up to [3,580] Attack Rating.
Breakthrough: Applies an Armor Up Buff, granting [2,250] Armor for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Remove all currently active Breakthroughs dealing [3,580] damage per Breakthrough removed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Reset the duration of any currently active Breakthrough Effect.
If no Breakthroughs are currently active it triggers the Breakthrough of whichever category is currently Highest.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Trigger the Breakthrough effect of all Research Categories currently at 100, and reset the duration of all Breakthroughs to 3.5 seconds per Category currently at 100.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Duplicate 1 Currently active Breakthrough(s) with a duration of 5 seconds.
This Duration increases by 10 seconds per currently active Breakthrough.
